summary: The reviewed research does not establish a qualifying benefit for this product's assessed use. Existing human research is kept: the 2025 prediabetes broccoli-sprout-extract RCT missed its prespecified primary target (observed -0.2 mmol/L), plus the former-smoker Ki-67 trial and the autism meta-analysis. None of the three sources measures the record's goals (Healthy Aging/Longevity, Immune Support). The prediabetes BSE trial missed its prespecified primary target (observed -0.2 mmol/L), the former-smoker trial reports only a bronchial Ki-67 biomarker, and the autism meta-analysis is off-claim. Dr. Pham also rejected primary-target success, cancer-prevention and preparation-wide claims. The record becomes reference-only, which removes sulforaphane Evidence points from dependent products (about 6 per the closure plan).

identity.preparation: Broccoli sprout extract delivering sulforaphane; not arbitrary broccoli powder or unverified glucoraphanin conversion.

population.description: Drug-naive adults with prediabetes (mean age about 63; baseline fasting glucose 6.4 mmol/L); 89 randomized (44 BSE, 45 placebo), 74 with full follow-up (35 BSE, 39 placebo).

study_contexts.study_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, 12 weeks; prespecified primary outcome a 0.3 mmol/L fasting-glucose reduction versus placebo.

outcomes.name: Prespecified fasting-glucose reduction target of 0.3 mmol/L versus placebo was not met.
Observed overall fasting-glucose change -0.2 mmol/L (95% CI -0.44 to -0.01; P=0.04); HbA1c -0.3 mmol/mol (-1.3 to 0.6); responder and microbiome subgroups exploratory.

limitations: No cancer prevention, universal prediabetes treatment or product-wide benefit inferred.
Source reports molar exposure; no unsupported milligram value is created to fit mass-only dose vocabulary.
Returned decision: Reject primary-target success, cancer-prevention, and preparation-wide claims.
No credit: prediabetes glucose is not this record's Healthy Aging/Immune goal, the primary target was missed, and 15 participants were lost mainly to gastrointestinal side effects (9 BSE, 6 placebo).
Context authored and source-verified by agent review (Claude) on 2026-10-28; Dr. Pham's pre-approval of fully source-verified contexts attested by Sean on 2026-10-28.

dose.administration_frequency: 150 micromol sulforaphane per dose once daily in the morning for 12 weeks; preparation suspended in approximately 1 dL water. No mass conversion invented.
dosage_forms: broccoli sprout extract suspended in water
co_therapies: Participants were drug-naive; placebo and study conditions are retained separately.
dose.reported_regimen: 150 micromol sulforaphane per dose once daily in the morning for 12 weeks; preparation suspended in approximately 1 dL water. No mass conversion invented.

normalization.basis: Preserve the specifically identified material or component quantity; no elemental/marker conversion or extrapolated daily dose.

source_provenance.location: Full text (PMC11879859): Results paragraph 1 (150 umol once daily, 12 weeks, dropouts), Table 1, Table 2 endpoints, Methods (dosing, Lantmannen BSE preparation).

clinical_review.notes: Dr. Pham's returned decision rejects cancer-prevention claims; this bronchial Ki-67 biomarker trial in former smokers cannot support the record's Healthy Aging/Immune goals.

limitations: Abstract: 43 former smokers randomized to placebo or about 95 umol sulforaphane daily for 12 months; 37 completed; no effect on bronchial histopathology; Ki-67 index fell 20% versus a 65% rise with placebo (P=0.014). Biomarker only; full text not retrieved.
Context authored and source-verified by agent review (Claude) on 2026-10-28; Dr. Pham's pre-approval of fully source-verified contexts attested by Sean on 2026-10-28.

clinical_review.notes: Autism symptom outcomes are outside the record's Healthy Aging/Immune goals, and Dr. Pham rejected preparation-wide claims; no credit.

source_provenance.location: Full text retrieved (PMC12127520); figures from the abstract; included-trial list not re-encoded.

limitations: Meta-analysis (full text retrieved): 6 RCTs in autism spectrum disorder; total symptoms SMD -0.27 (-0.42 to -0.12), aberrant behavior -0.43, hyperactivity -0.58; irritability, anxiety and several social subscales not significant (abstract figures). Sulforaphane preparations and exposures differ.
Context authored and source-verified by agent review (Claude) on 2026-10-28; Dr. Pham's pre-approval of fully source-verified contexts attested by Sean on 2026-10-28.
